## Objective
- Continue and complete the existing playable game, making reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game or apply changes to the existing game.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Treated “Comtinue” as a request to continue the existing game.
- Fixed duplicate choice handling and corrected upgrade/equipment behavior discovered during code review.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the earlier duplicate `choose()` implementation in `game.js`, leaving the later implementation that includes hero skill bonuses.
- Updated Fortune’s Favor to accurately describe its effect and award 10 gold immediately when purchased.
- Removed an unintended extra gold reward when equipping the Pilgrim’s Key.
- Verified `node --check game.js` and simulated all three campaigns through their first-choice routes; each reached and rendered an ending.
- Generated `/tmp/opencode/latest.png` at 1280px wide and inspected it.

### Active
- Finish the visual check by producing and inspecting a JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- JPEG conversion was unavailable: `convert`, `magick`, `cjpeg`, and Python PIL were missing. Chromium generated `/tmp/opencode/latest.png`, but the required `.jpg` has not been produced.

## Next Move
1. Convert `/tmp/opencode/latest.png` to `/tmp/opencode/latest.jpg` using an available image tool or browser screenshot option, then inspect that latest JPEG.
2. Run `git status --short` and report the resulting uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing game and the fixes made during this session.
- `styles.css`: Existing game styling, relevant to visual verification.
- `index.html`: Game entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/latest.png`: Latest generated visual screenshot, awaiting JPEG conversion.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; none were staged or committed.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because its expected Chromium installation is absent. System Chromium at `/usr/bin/chromium` successfully generated the PNG screenshot.
- A `python3 -m http.server 3002` server was started in the background.
